## Experience

## Projects

- Biasly — AI news analysis platform detecting political bias, sentiment and editorial framing across major news sources. Automated pipeline: Oxylabs scraping, validation and dedup, AI analysis via Vercel AI SDK, pgvector embeddings, hourly Vercel Cron scheduling. Stack: Next.js, TypeScript, Supabase, Vercel AI SDK, Oxylabs, pgvector, Claude Code. Live: https://biasly.app — Source: https://github.com/manoj4089/biasly
- Spill — anonymous social app with mood-based matching, real-time chat and WebRTC voice, shipped to web, iOS and Android via Capacitor. Currently in progress.
- KG Goat Farm — zero-build marketing site for a wholesale goat farm, built with plain HTML/CSS/JS, GSAP and Lenis. Live: https://manoj4089.github.io/kg-project/ — Source: https://github.com/manoj4089/kg-project
